base_member_text: L79 'EtaScreen=ETA(I,J)' uses scalar indices I,J outside any loop (whole-array intent implied by ETAtmp=EtaScreen at L80) — under UseEtaScreen this assigns only one element whose I,J values are leftovers from the caller; likely intended EtaScreen=ETA.
audit_member_text: Use-before-assign/range defect in the UseEtaScreen build: L79 evaluates ETA(I,J) before this subroutine's I and J loops assign them at L83-L84. Because EtaScreen is assigned from that single indexed scalar before ETAtmp=EtaScreen at L80, stale imported loop indices can also cause an out-of-range read or fill the screen from the wrong cell; the commented L75 suggests the intended source was the full ETA array.

base_member_text: Flood sweep reads MASK(I-1..I+1,J-1..J+1) at I=Ibeg-2..Iend+2 (L83-84), touching indices down to Ibeg-3 only via DepthX(I+1,J) at L157 style writes — boundary index extent relies on ghost width Nghost>=3.
audit_member_text: Range contract is unchecked: the update loops reach Ibeg-2..Iend+2 and Jbeg-2..Jend+2 at L83-L84 while neighbor expressions read I-1/I+1 and J-1/J+1 (L90-L124 and L156-L159), requiring at least three valid halo cells; no local bound or Nghost check enforces that precondition.

base_member_text: MASK9tmp is assigned only over Jbeg-1..Jend+1 x Ibeg-1..Iend+1 (L175-176) but MASK9=MASK9tmp copies the whole allocated array (L193), leaving outer ghost rows of MASK9 from uninitialized MASK9tmp memory until PHI_INT_EXCH (L201, PARALLEL only).
audit_member_text: Partial-initialization defect: MASK9tmp is allocated over all Mloc,Nloc at L63 but assigned only for I=Ibeg-1..Iend+1 and J=Jbeg-1..Jend+1 at L175-L191. L193 copies the entire temporary array into MASK9, so any allocated ghost extent outside those ranges receives uninitialized values before exchanges at L200-L201.

base_member_text: Dmass accumulation (L136/L138) uses (ETAtmp-ETA) but the version-3.4 line that made ETAtmp differ from ETA (L132 'ETAtmp(I,J)=MinDepth-Depth(I,J)') is commented out; in the non-UseEtaScreen build ETAtmp is never assigned before use, so the summand is undefined-minus-ETA; in the UseEtaScreen build ETAtmp=EtaScreen (L80).
audit_member_text: Use-before-assign in the ordinary build: ETAtmp is allocated at L64, its full initialization ETAtmp=ETA is commented out at L75, and its only live assignment is inside UseEtaScreen at L80, yet both drying-mass branches read ETAtmp(I,J) unconditionally at L136/L138. Without UseEtaScreen, Dmass is computed from uninitialized allocation contents.

base_member_text: MASK9tmp is INTEGER (L57) but assigned ZERO (L185), a REAL(SP) named constant from PARAM — implicit conversion.

CHECK_MASS_CONSERVATION correction subtracts DwetEta from all wet cells every call (L240-244) — global mass redistribution; comment L208 says it is 'a general setting after tests' though it remains behind an ifdef.

audit_member_text: Ineffective singularity guard: L235 divides by Max(DX*DY,WetArea), and L237 divides by Max(DX(1,1)*DY(1,1),WetArea). Max chooses a denominator but does not impose a positive floor, so zero area and zero spacing still yield division by zero.
